notes: Verifies Requirement 7.1 along the scope.terminals axis. Distinct from `pos-cross-device-binding` (which stays inside parent.scope.terminals); this vector documents the boundary between legal cross-device DELEGATE and illegal terminal expansion.

post_state.note: Rejection does not mutate any state; the parent Mandate remains Active. No child Mandate is issued and no signature.chain entry is produced.

signature_verification.note: Real Ed25519 signatures over canonical CBOR. The child Mandate's signature.chain reproduces the ancestor outer signatures so verifiers can walk root → MS-Cert → ... → parent → child without out-of-band trust.

summary: Negative DELEGATE: child.scope.terminals targets 'terminal:tablet:roaming-1' which is NOT in parent.scope.terminals. Must be rejected with E_PROTOCOL (1099).
